units.source_text: 三公主定于初十之后赴朱雀院贺寿。

en.t: The Third Princess was scheduled to visit Suzaku-in after the tenth day to offer birthday congratulations.

units.source_text: 六条院殿内练习舞乐，热闹得很。

en.t: Inside the Rokujoin residence, rehearsals for the court dances and music were under way, and everything was very lively.

units.source_text: 在二条院养病的紫夫人还未归来，听说六条院试演舞乐，心思静不下来，也就迁回来了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki, who had been recovering from illness at Nijoin and had not yet returned, heard that the dance and music rehearsal would be held at Rokujoin, could not settle her mind, and so moved back there.
The Akashi Consort also came home for a visit.

units.source_text: 她此次所生的又是一个皇子。

en.t: The child she had borne this time was again a prince.

units.source_text: 她的子女成群，个个都长得非常可爱，源氏朝夕含饴弄孙，自喜老年多福。

en.t: She had many children, and every one of them was charming; morning and evening Genji doted on his grandchildren and rejoiced in the blessings of his old age.

units.source_text: 试演舞乐之时，髭黑右大臣的夫人玉鬘也来观赏。

en.t: At the dance and music rehearsal, Tamakazura, wife of Higekuro the Minister of the Right, also came to watch.

units.source_text: 夕雾在试演之前，先在东北院练习音乐，每日朝夕演奏，花散里听得多了，所以试演之日不来观赏。

en.t: Before the rehearsal, Yugiri had first practiced the music at the northeast residence, playing every morning and evening; Hanachirusato had heard so much of it that she did not come to watch on the day of the rehearsal.

units.source_text: 柏木卫门督不参加这个盛会，未免美中不足，使人觉得扫兴。

en.t: That Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, did not take part in this splendid gathering was inevitably a flaw in the perfection and left people disappointed.

units.source_text: 而且外人也要奇怪，疑心有何原因。

en.t: Moreover, outsiders too would find it strange and suspect that there was some reason for it.

units.source_text: 因此源氏只得派人前去邀他。

en.t: For this reason, Genji had no choice but to send someone to invite him.

units.source_text: 柏木以病重为由，婉言辞谢。

en.t: Kashiwagi politely declined, giving serious illness as his reason.

units.source_text: 源氏想道：“他虽然如此说，其实并无重病，定是心中有所顾虑。”

en.t: Genji thought, "Although he says this, he is not in fact gravely ill; surely there is something weighing on his mind."

units.source_text: 他觉得可怜，便特地写一封信去邀请。

en.t: Feeling sorry for him, Genji went out of his way to write a letter inviting him.

units.source_text: 柏木的父亲前太政大臣也劝柏木：“你为什么辞谢？

en.t: Kashiwagi's father, the former Chancellor, also urged him, "Why are you refusing?

units.source_text: 六条院大人将误解你有何用意呢！

en.t: Lord Rokujoin will misunderstand and think you have some hidden intention.

units.source_text: 你又没有大病，耐着性子去吧。”

en.t: You are not seriously ill, so bear with it and go."

units.source_text: 柏木蒙源氏再度相邀，觉得情面难却，便到六条院来了。

en.t: Having been invited by Genji a second time, Kashiwagi felt that courtesy made it hard to refuse, and so he came to Rokujoin.
